name: Amazon SES
solves: Provides the AWS SDK for Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) to send transactional and bulk email at scale via API or SMTP, with configuration sets, templates, bounce/complaint handling, and deep AWS IAM integration.
best_for: High-volume transactional email on AWS where SES pricing and deliverability tooling matter
Teams already operating in AWS that want IAM-authenticated email sending without a third-party ESP
Serverless Lambdas sending mail via @aws-sdk/client-ses or SES v2 APIs
Organizations needing configuration sets, event publishing to SNS/Firehose, and dedicated IPs
Cost-sensitive workloads past startup ESP free tiers
skip_when: You want the simplest DX with React email templates and a modern API (consider Resend)
You are not on AWS and do not want to manage domain verification, IAM, and sandbox limits
You need a self-hosted SMTP relay with Nodemailer against your own MTA
You prefer Postmark/Mailgun's focused deliverability UX over raw AWS console/API
Your stack is non-JS and you would use a different SES SDK anyway
